prompt:
A Binary Search Tree (BST) is constructed by sequentially inserting the following keys into an initially empty tree:
`[205, 155, 255, 130, 180, 230, 280]`

What is the exact **Postorder** traversal sequence of this tree?
explanation: Postorder traversal visits Left Subtree -> Right Subtree -> Root. Root 205 is processed last after all its children: [130, 180, 155, 230, 280, 255, 205].
